title: zeshicast extension.toml
description: Manifest of a zeshicast extension. See docs/extensions.md.

name.description: Shown in search results and the extension browser.

version.description: The extension's own version (free form; semver recommended).

protocol.description: JSON-RPC protocol version the binaries speak. Required when `binaries` is set; any other value keeps them from running.

capabilities.description: Ceiling for everything in the extension. A command still needs each capability in its own `permissions`.

commands.description: Command definitions, `*.toml` paths relative to the extension directory.

scripts.description: Script commands with `@raycast.*` / `@vicinae.*` metadata comments. Need the `shell` capability.

binaries.description: Executable JSON-RPC extensions. Need the `shell` capability and `protocol`.

relativePath.description: Relative to the extension directory; absolute paths and `..` are ignored.
